The assessment and management of our cybersecurity risks covers all of our internal systems, the systems of third parties who maintain our data, and our use of artificial intelligence.

As part of our processes to manage risks from cybersecurity threats and our use of artificial intelligence, we have developed and enforce company-wide policies related to password encryption, strength and expiration, we require multi-factor authentication where appropriate, conduct regular employee training about our policies and cybersecurity threats, and we have adopted a policy on use of artificial intelligence.
